headline: Sales grow but profit growth stalls
summary_short: Revenue was KRW 1.49T, up 18.5% y/y, and operating profit was KRW 640.1B, up only 1.0% y/y, while net profit fell 21.2% to KRW 391.1B.
summary_long: Operating margin was about 43%, down 7.5 points from a year earlier. Third-party coverage says the quarter beat consensus on revenue and operating profit. Coverage also reports that the company raised its 2026 revenue growth outlook to 20%; this was not checked against the release. No drivers are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Figures come from search-result snippets of third-party coverage. Shard y/y comparisons and operating income (KRW 738.5B) do not match the reported figures and are not used. Net profit matches the Yahoo shard.
